title: Simple Private Noisy SGD is Minimax-Optimal under Population Strong Convexity
abstract: arXiv:2611.26515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is at the center of modern machine learning and is known to be statistically minimax-optimal in many regression settings, e.g., for convex Generalized Linear Models (GLMs). Yet, it is unknown whether its simplest differentially private Noisy SGD counterpart fulfills similar favorable guarantees even on strongly convex losses. We resolve this question affirmatively. We upper bound the parameter estimation error for a single pass of Noisy SGD with a fixed stepsize schedule and constant batch sizes on smooth and strongly convex Lipschitz losses over a compact convex domain under Renyi DP. Specialized to strongly convex GLMs, our error bounds match minimax lower bounds we derive based on the Score Attack framework. In particular, this provides the first minimax-optimal rate for Noisy SGD in private logistic regression, avoiding poly-logarithmic terms present in existing results. Our analysis is versatile a

translated_title: 简单的隐私保护噪声SGD在总体强凸性下是极小极大最优的
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是现代机器学习的核心，并且在许多回归场景中已被证明具有统计上的极小极大最优性，例如凸的广义线性模型（GLMs）。然而，尚不清楚其最简单的差分隐私版本——噪声SGD（Noisy SGD）——即使在强凸损失函数上是否也能享有同样良好的保证。我们对这一问题给出了肯定的答案。我们在紧凸域上的光滑、强凸且满足Lipschitz条件的损失函数下，在Rényi差分隐私框架内，针对采用固定步长调度和恒定批量大小的单次噪声SGD，给出了参数估计误差的上界。当专门应用于强凸GLMs时，我们的误差上界与我们基于Score Attack框架推导出的极小极大下界相匹配。特别地，这为隐私保护的逻辑回归中的噪声SGD提供了首个极小极大最优的收敛速率，避免了现有结果中出现的多项式对数因子项。我们的分析方法具有广泛的通用性……
tldr: 本文证明了在强凸损失（尤其是强凸广义线性模型，如隐私逻辑回归）上，采用固定步长的单次噪声SGD即可达到极小极大最优的估计误差率，其上界与基于Score Attack框架推导的隐私下界相匹配，并首次消除了对数因子。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a single pass of Noisy SGD with a fixed stepsize schedule is minimax-optimal for smooth strongly convex losses, matching Score Attack-based lower bounds and yielding the first minimax-optimal rate for private logistic regression without poly-logarithmic factors.
